body:
Each tab shows its designs in a flat list on the left side of the screen, and picking one opens it. Designs can't be drawn yet, so opening one shows its title for now.

### Do

- Load designs from `GET /designs` and show the current tab's designs, each by title, in a flat list on the left.
- Picking a design opens it in the rest of the page, showing its title for now. Later tasks draw it there.
- The design that is open is in the address with the tab, so a reload or Back returns to it.
- The list updates when a design is added or changed, the same way other pages follow live changes.

### Acceptance

- Tests: each tab lists only its own designs, picking one opens it, and the address round-trips the open design.
- A design from the other tab, or one that no longer exists, in the address opens nothing and doesn't break the page.

### Left out

Grouping or arranging designs, search, and creating a design here: designs come from the design agent. Ask the human what the list shows when a tab has no designs.
title: design: list designs on the left
